claims.text: The Pulumi for Terraform Users guide covers referencing Terraform state files, using any Terraform provider in Pulumi, importing Terraform modules directly, converting HCL to Pulumi, and orchestrating Terraform and Pulumi together.
Pulumi provides a `terraform.state.S3Reference` resource (from @pulumi/terraform) that takes `bucket` and `key` arguments to reference Terraform state in S3.
`S3Reference` exposes a `getOutput` method to read outputs from Terraform state.
`pulumi.StackReference` with `getOutput` retrieves outputs from another Pulumi stack.
`aws.ecs.Cluster` accepts `configuration.executeCommandConfiguration` with `kmsKeyId` and `logging: "DEFAULT"`.
`pulumi import` can bring Terraform-managed resources under Pulumi management.
Pulumi supports transferring state ownership gradually, resource-by-resource, from Terraform to Pulumi.
`pulumi import` takes the syntax `pulumi import <type> <name> <id>`, e.g. `aws:ec2/vpc:Vpc main-vpc vpc-12345`.
Pulumi policies can enforce infrastructure policies across both Terraform and Pulumi resources.
`@pulumi/policy` exports `PolicyPack` and `validateResourceOfType`, and policies accept `enforcementLevel: "mandatory"` and `validateResource`.
`pulumi.LocalWorkspace.createOrSelectStack` is available from `@pulumi/pulumi/automation` with stackName, projectName, program options.
The example imports `pulumi` from `@pulumi/pulumi/automation` and uses `pulumi.terraform.state.S3Reference`, implying the terraform state namespace is available there.
`stack.setConfig` and `stack.up({ onOutput })` are Automation API methods.
Component resources can integrate with Terraform behind the scenes, leaving multi-tool complexity to platform teams.
Doc pages exist at /docs/intro/concepts/, /docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/, /docs/intro/vs/terraform/, /docs/iac/concepts/automation-api/, /docs/insights/policy/.
Pulumi Community page offers a community slack and forum.
The pulumi/examples repository contains hundreds of real-world examples.
Pulumi YouTube channel is at youtube.com/pulumitv.
Pulumi case studies exist for Snowflake (using Pulumi with existing tools), Mercedes-Benz (large-scale modernization), and Lemonade (Pulumi and Terraform).
Pulumi Support provides professional support for Pulumi Cloud customers.
Link targets exist: pulumi/pulumi CONTRIBUTING.md on master, /docs/iac/guides/building-extending/, pulumi/examples CONTRIBUTING.md.
Pulumi has an events page at /events/ and a user groups page at /community/.
